header.running_head: Relationships between Men, Women and Children

blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) reports that Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) said, "When the verses giving (us) the choice were revealed, Rasulullaah ﷺ began with me before any of his other wives. He said, 'I am about to present to you a choice about which you are in no hurry to decide until you have consulted with your parents.' Rasulullaah ﷺ said this despite knowing well that my parents would never tell me to separate from Rasulullaah ﷺ. Rasulullaah ﷺ then continued, 'Allaah says:

blocks.arabic_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِّأَزْوَاجِكَ إِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ الْحَيَوٰةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِينَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ أُمَتِّعْكُنَّ وَأُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيلًا ۝ وَإِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَدَّ لِلْمُحْسِنَاتِ مِنْكُنَّ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا
blocks.text: O Nabi ﷺ! Say to your wives, "If you desire the life of this world and its adornments, then come forward. I shall grant you a generous provision and separate from you (divorce you) in a cordial manner. However, if you desire Allaah, His Rasool ﷺ and the home of the Aakhirah, then (you may continue enjoying the status of being his wives and living with the allowance he provides because) Allaah has certainly prepared a grand reward for those of you who do good deeds (Allaah will reward you tremendously for your sacrifice)."

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) says, "I immediately said, "Is there anything to consult my parents about? I certainly want Allaah, His Rasool ﷺ and the home of the Aakhirah.'" Rasulullaah ﷺ then presented the choice to all his wives and the reply each of them gave was similar to that of Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA). [^2]
Another narration quotes that Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) said, "When Rasulullaah ﷺ gave us a choice and we chose (to remain with) him, he did not count this (choice as a divorce) against us." [^3]
Rasulullaah ﷺ's Relationship with Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) and Hadhrat Maymoonah (RA)

Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) reports that Rasulullaah ﷺ once said to her, "I know exactly when you are happy with me and when you are angry." When she asked Rasulullaah ﷺ how he knew that, he replied, "When you are happy with me, you say, 'No, by the Rabb of Muhammad ﷺ!' and when you are angry with me, you say, 'No, by the Rabb of Ibraheem (AS).'" "That's true," Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) said, "but it is only your name that I leave out (while the love for you in my heart remains just as strong)." [^4]
Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) narrates, "I was once on a journey with Rasulullaah ﷺ
Ibn Abi Haatim. Bukhaari and Muslim have reported a similar narration.
